integrity: Proof and standalone finite verifier supplied; finite enumerations support but do not establish the unrestricted theorem. Novelty remains subject to independent literature review.
scientific_limitations: Odd finite fields only; nondegenerate symmetric bilinear forms and rank-one square. Previously published solvable-case modularity is credited and not claimed as novel. No complete algebra-isomorphism classification or characteristic-two census is asserted.
title: Dimension-resolved subalgebra census for nondegenerate rank-one evolution algebras
